result.headline: No control-surface fault found; one early low-voltage warning, roll lags setpoint about 1 s, and several recording artifacts.
result.explanation: Roll follows its setpoint (corr 0.982 at 0.97 s lag), and actuator outputs move with the commands. Pitch, yaw and start-up 'divergences' look like sign, wrap or stale-sample artifacts. Only battery and tuning remain open.

evidence.quote: EVENT t=1.339 s controller.event[mavros: Battery] mavros: Battery: WARN: Low voltage
evidence.shows: The only event in the recording, at 1.3 s. No battery voltage series exists to say how low or whether it recovered.

evidence.quote: TRACKING vehicle.attitude[roll] diverged from its setpoint from t=0.009 to 1.632 s (peak |error| 95.941 deg)
evidence.shows: The first roll setpoint sample is +44.95 and the next is -44.77 at 0.438 s. Attitude was already near -51 deg, so the first sample looks stale and the divergence is a start-up artifact.

evidence.quote: CHANGE control.attitude_setpoint[pitch] at t=5.481 s: 13.16 -> -10.56 deg (step -23.72, 131.8x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: Pitch attitude moves the opposite way (line 57, -11.866 -> 10.134). Correlation is -0.761 at 1.2 s lag, so the pitch sign convention probably differs and the pitch 'divergence' is not a fault.

evidence.quote: CHANGE vehicle.attitude[yaw] at t=3.259 s: 13.648 -> 130.893 deg (step 117.245, 174.9x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: In the 0-8 s window yaw rises smoothly (1.15 -> 143.9 deg), and later yaw runs on unwrapped to -559. The step is probably a sampling or unwrap artifact, not a jump of the aircraft.

evidence.quote: CHANGE propulsion.throttle at t=114.853 s: 35 -> 0 % (step -35, 17.5x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: Throttle goes to 0 and stays there. ch[2] sits at 1100 us from 117.5 s, so it follows the throttle command. The cause of the cut is not in the data.

checked.result: Correlation 0.8 raw, 0.982 at 0.974 s lag. Typical difference 4.345 deg, worst 38.211 deg at 34.059 s.
checked.about: Roll control or actuator fault; it also shows about 1 s of response lag.

checked.result: Correlation -0.316 raw, -0.761 at 1.217 s lag. Typical difference 3.048 deg.
checked.about: Pitch sign convention or mapping, not a pitch fault.

checked.check: Sequence of departures from baseline, 0-8 s
checked.result: No series left baseline before the low-voltage event, so no earliest sign could be identified.

checked.check: Actuator outputs vs attitude and throttle, 0-8 s and 112-132 s
checked.result: ch[2] follows throttle (1644 us at 68%; 1100 us at 0%). ch[1], ch[3], ch[4] and ch[5] move with roll. No output is frozen or has a one-sided step during the maneuvers.

effects.quote: ANOMALY a1 t=0.009 s: vehicle.attitude[roll] did not follow control.attitude_setpoint[roll] (peak |error| 95.941) (see line 79; strength 3.769)
effects.why: Start-up stale setpoint sample, not a fault.

effects.quote: ANOMALY a2 t=3.259 s: vehicle.attitude[yaw] stepped 13.648 -> 130.893 deg (see line 63; strength 3.368)
effects.why: Likely sample-gap or yaw-wrap artifact. Yaw is continuous in the window.

effects.quote: ANOMALY a11 t=105.992 s: vehicle.velocity[y] stepped 18.29 -> -3.81 m/s (see line 71; strength 3.176)
effects.why: Velocity steps coincide with large roll and yaw maneuvers (about 105-108 s). A sampling effect is likely.

hypotheses.claim: The roll loop lags its setpoint by about 1 s, which causes the larger tracking errors.
hypotheses.because: Corr 0.982 at 0.974 s lag in 20-100 s, with typical difference 4.345 deg.

hypotheses.claim: The flagged divergences come from stale first samples, an inverted pitch sign and yaw unwrap.
hypotheses.because: Pitch correlation is -0.761 at lag; the first roll setpoint sample is stale; yaw is continuous within windows.
